from collections import Counter

def infer_period(grid):
    cells=[(r+c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) if r>=3 for c,v in enumerate(row) if c>=3 and v!=0]
    candidates=[]
    for p in range(2,13):
        buckets=[Counter() for _ in range(p)]
        for s,v in cells: buckets[s%p][v]+=1
        mapping=[b.most_common(1)[0][0] if b else None for b in buckets]
        score=sum(b[m] for b,m in zip(buckets,mapping) if m is not None)
        candidates.append((score,p,mapping,score/len(cells)))
    return sorted(candidates, reverse=True, key=lambda x:(x[0],-x[1]))
print(infer_period(demo_grid)[:5])
